import tomlkit
from tomlkit import dumps
from tomlkit.items import Table


def test_issue_411_dump_nested_dotted_table():
    # https://github.com/python-poetry/tomlkit/issues/411
    # dumps() of a sub-table loses one nesting level.
    a = tomlkit.parse("a.b.c.d='e'")["a"]
    assert a == {"b": {"c": {"d": "e"}}}
    assert dumps(a) == "b.c.d='e'"


def test_issue_411_dump_nested_dotted_table_two_levels():
    doc = tomlkit.parse("a.b.c = 1\na.b.d = 2\n")
    sub = doc["a"]["b"]
    assert sub == {"c": 1, "d": 2}
    out = dumps(sub)
    assert out == "c = 1\nd = 2\n"


def test_issue_411_dumps_accepts_table_instance():
    # dumps() should accept a Table/InlineTable directly without
    # re-wrapping it into a plain dict (which loses style and nesting).
    doc = tomlkit.parse("[a]\nb = 1\n")
    table = doc["a"]
    assert isinstance(table, Table)
    assert dumps(table) == "b = 1\n"


def test_issue_377_no_empty_parent_header_for_super_table():
    # https://github.com/python-poetry/tomlkit/issues/377
    # Adding a second sub-table should not produce an empty parent header.
    doc = tomlkit.document()

    def add_table(parent, name):
        parent.add(name, tomlkit.table())
        return parent[name]

    root = add_table(doc, "root")
    add_table(root, "first")
    add_table(root, "second")

    out = dumps(doc)
    assert "[root]\n" not in out
    assert "[root.first]" in out
    assert "[root.second]" in out


def test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip():
    # https://github.com/python-poetry/tomlkit/issues/381
    # Dumping a parsed doc whose last AOT entry lacks a trailing newline
    # must not corrupt the output.
    content = (
        '[[products]]\nname = "Hammer"\n\n[foo]\n\n[bar]\n\n[[products]]\nname = "Nail"'
    )
    doc = tomlkit.parse(content)
    out = doc.as_string()
    # The dumped output must still be parseable and preserve the data.
    reparsed = tomlkit.parse(out)
    assert reparsed == doc
    assert reparsed["products"] == [{"name": "Hammer"}, {"name": "Nail"}]
    assert reparsed["foo"] == {}
    assert reparsed["bar"] == {}
"
  }
}

Empty table dumped when number of subtables > 1

With the following code and `tomlkit 0.13`:

```python
import tomlkit

doc = tomlkit.document()

def add_table(parent, name):
    parent.add(name, tomlkit.table())
    return parent[name]


root = add_table(doc, 'root')
first = add_table(root, "first")
print(tomlkit.dumps(doc))  # -> [root.first]   (correct)

second = add_table(root, "second")
print(tomlkit.dumps(doc))  # -> [root]\n[root.first]\n\n[root.second]\n  (wrong: empty [root] header appears)
```

When a super table has more than one sub-table, dumping produces an empty `[root]` header that should not be shown. With a single sub-table the output is correct.

With the following code and `tomlkit 0.13`:

```python
import tomlkit

doc = tomlkit.document()

def add_table(parent, name):
    parent.add(name, tomlkit.table())
    return parent[name]

first = add_table(root, "first")
print(tomlkit.dumps(doc))  # -> [root.first]   (correct)

second = add_table(root, "second")

```

Empty table dumped when number of subtables > 1

With the following code and `tomlkit 0.13`:

```python
import tomlkit

doc = tomlkit.document()

    parent.add(name, tomlkit.table())
    return parent[name]

print(tomlkit.dumps(doc))  # -> [root.first]   (correct)

second = add_table(root, "second")
print(tomlkit.dumps(doc))  # -> [root]\n[root.first]\n\n[root.second]\n  (wrong: empty [root] header appears)
```

steps.observation:
## LOCALIZE 阶段（分析）

现在我已经完全理解了问题。让我分析 `is_super_table()` 方法（items.py:1619-1625）：

```python
def is_super_table(self) -> bool:
    if self._is_super_table is not None:
        return self._is_super_table
    # If the table has only one child and that child is a table, then it is a super table.
    if len(self) != 1:
        return False
    only_child = next(iter(self.values()))
    return isinstance(only_child, (Table, AoT))
```

**问题根因**：当 `root` 表通过 `tomlkit.table()` 创建时，`_is_super_table` 为 `None`，走 fallback 逻辑。fallback 只检查"恰好一个子表"的情况（`len(self) != 1` → False）。当 `root` 有两个子表 `first` 和 `second` 时，`len(self) == 2`，所以 `is_super_table()` 返回 `False`，导致 `_render_table` 输出空的 `[root]` header。

**修复方向**：fallback 逻辑应改为检查"所有子项都是 Table/AoT"（而非"恰好一个子表"）。这样多子表场景也能正确识别为 super table，不输出空 header。`_render_table` 中已有 `any(not isinstance(v, (Table, AoT, Whitespace, Null))...)` 检查来处理含非表项的情况，所以修改是安全的。

import tomlkit

import tomlkit
